abstract: A Workday and Hanover Research report examining how AI is reshaping workforce capabilities and organizational dynamics. Among respondents actively using or experimenting with AI, 93% believe it enables them to focus on higher-level responsibilities, with 53% viewing AI primarily as a tool for augmenting human capabilities to drive productivity and innovation rather than replacing workers.
keyFindings: 93% of respondents actively using or experimenting with AI agree that it allows them to focus more on higher-level responsibilities
53% of respondents believe AI will augment human capabilities, leading to increased productivity and new forms of innovation
The majority view AI as a complementary technology that enhances rather than displaces human work
methodology: Not specified in available excerpt. Survey-based research conducted by Workday and Hanover Research as of January 8, 2025, examining respondent perspectives on AI adoption and workforce impact.
qualifiers: Limited content available due to cookie/access restrictions on source page. Findings reported for 'respondents actively using or experimenting with AI,' indicating sample may not be representative of all workers or organizations. Full methodology, sample size, and geographic scope not specified in available excerpt.
